packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator responsible for a flight, submitting the ATC flight plan and providing TOBT and related estimates.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party performing turn-round and ground handling operations on behalf of, or alongside, the Aircraft Operator.

classes.name: AirTrafficControlUnit
classes.definition: Any ATC unit (Area Control Centre, Approach Control, Tower, or ATS unit) that receives the flight plan, detects the flight, or issues approvals.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, receives DPI messages, and monitors flight progress via ETFMS/FUM.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the submitted ATC flight plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and aircrew who request start-up, coordinate boarding and turn-round management, and receive TSAT confirmation.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The stakeholder responsible for stand and gate allocation, sharing EOBT and reacting to stand/gate change decisions.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single scheduled arrival or departure operation of an aircraft, carrying an operational status that changes at each milestone.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round linking an arriving flight and its related departing flight, including the defined turn-round period.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft operating a flight, identified by type and registration, which may be updated from the flight plan.

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC flight plan submitted for a flight, possibly as part of a repetitive flight plan (RFPL), describing departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to a flight at a coordinated airport, against which the ATC flight plan and airport flight data are checked for consistency.

classes.name: Aerodrome
classes.definition: An airport, whether the departure, destination, or outstation aerodrome, involved in a flight's origin or destination.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the off-block event (SOBT, EOBT, TOBT, or AOBT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update; every successive value is kept.

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the landing event (ELDT or ALDT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the in-block event (EIBT or AIBT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the take-off event (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, or ATOT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: A time quantity for the start-up approval event (TSAT or ASAT), recorded with its prefix, origin, and time of update.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which start-up is requested (ASRT), recorded with its origin and time of update.

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back (ARDT), recorded with its origin and time of update.

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual start boarding time (ASBT) at which the gate opens for passengers to board.

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The actual commence of ground handling time (ACGT), applicable to first-of-day or long-parked flights.

classes.name: TaxiTime
classes.definition: An estimated taxi duration, either taxi-out (EXOT) or taxi-in (EXIT), used in the calculation of other time quantities.

classes.name: MinimumTurnRoundTime
classes.definition: The minimum turn-round time (MTTT) defined for an aircraft type, used as a calculation basis for TTOT.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 1: checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, airport slot, and airport flight data, and confirms the flight to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

classes.name: RegulationCheckMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 2 (EOBT-2hr): checks AO/GH flight estimates against the ATC Flight Plan, determines CTOT for regulated flights, and informs Network Operations via a T-DPI message.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 3: checks estimated landing times after take-off from the outstation against the outbound ATC Flight Plan and informs Network Operations via a T-DPI-t message.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdateMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 4: commences the TOBT process on radar detection of the flight in the FIR and checks TOBT feasibility, informing Network Operations of TTOT changes beyond tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproachMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 5: commences the TOBT process on radar detection of the flight on final approach and checks TOBT feasibility against TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: LandedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 6: on ALDT, checks TOBT consistency with the ATC Flight Plan and updates downstream time estimates for the departing flight.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: on AIBT, checks TOBT consistency with the ATC Flight Plan and updates downstream time estimates for the departing flight.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStartedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 8: on ACGT, for first-of-day or long-parked flights, checks TOBT consistency with the ATC Flight Plan and updates downstream estimates.

classes.name: FinalTobtConfirmationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 9: checks that the AO/GH's most accurate TOBT, provided t minutes before EOBT, is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan prior to TSAT issue.

classes.name: TsatIssuedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 10: informs partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight and checks whether TOBT updates after TSAT issue exceed a locally defined tolerance.

classes.name: BoardingStartsMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 11: informs partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time and checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT.

classes.name: AircraftReadyMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 12: informs partners of the Actual Ready Time and alerts AO/GH if TOBT has passed without an ARDT or ready status message.

classes.name: StartUpRequestedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 13: informs partners of the Actual Start-Up Request Time and alerts partners if no start-up request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

classes.name: StartUpApprovedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 14: informs partners of the Actual Start-Up Approval Time and checks and alerts if approval is not aligned with or granted by TSAT tolerance.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: informs partners of the Actual Off-Block Time, updates TTOT considering EXOT, and triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: informs partners of the actual take-off, generates an airborne message, sends FSA and MVT messages, and removes the flight from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The Airport CDM Platform that is initiated per flight, processes all available flight information, computes updated times, and triggers the DPI process and partner notifications.

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC system that provides radar/system-derived times (ALDT, TSAT context) and calculates EXOT based on traffic load, gate/stand location, runway, and holding position.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code when it crosses a FIR/ATC boundary, a defined range/position, or a predetermined level.

classes.name: EtfmsSystem
classes.definition: The Network Operations system (ETFMS) that monitors a flight's progress within 3 hours flying time of the destination and issues Flight Update Messages.

classes.name: AcarsSystem
classes.definition: The ACARS system fitted to equipped aircraft that reports actual times such as landing, in-block, off-block, and take-off.

classes.name: AutomatedDockingSystem
classes.definition: An automated docking or ground surveillance system (e.g. A-SMGCS) that detects in-block, off-block, or take-off events.

classes.name: PassengerInformationSystem
classes.definition: The airport system, flight information display system (FIDS), or public address system used to inform passengers of boarding.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI) sent to Network Operations to convey updated flight time estimates.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM sent by Network Operations providing updates of a flight's progress used to update ELDT.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The RDY message confirming that the aircraft is ready and follows the indicated TOBT.

classes.name: DepartureClearanceMessage
classes.definition: The DCL message or voice communication by which flight crew requests start-up.

classes.name: TakeOffNotificationMessage
classes.definition: A notification message sent at take-off (FSA, MVT, or airborne message) informing partners and Network Operations of the actual take-off.

unmodelled: Milestone 1 refers to Attachment 2 for details of the DPI process implementation, which the document does not further specify.

The distinction between coordinated and non-coordinated airports (milestone 1), affecting whether the outbound flight is already known or must be initiated from the flight plan, is a rule about airport type rather than a standalone class.

The generic term 'Airport CDM Partners' used throughout milestones 9-16 to denote all stakeholders collectively is not modelled as its own class since it is a collective reference to the existing stakeholder classes.

Milestone 8 notes that Ground Handling Started is specific to flights that are the first operation of the day or have been long-term parked, a qualifying condition on when the milestone applies rather than a separate class.
Milestone 12 mentions roles such as Dispatcher/Supervisor/Redcap coordinating with the Ground Handler, which are not separately modelled beyond the GroundHandler stakeholder.
Section 3.7.3 referenced in milestone 1 for DPI process details is not included in the document and cannot be modelled further.
